name: unslop
purpose: Remove AI writing patterns while preserving meaning and intended tone.
triggers: Invoke unslop to edit prose; the source description says it must always apply.
outputs: Rewritten text that preserves meaning and intended tone.
ordinaryExample: Rewrite a supplied paragraph to remove chatbot praise, filler, jargon, and unnecessary passive voice without adding facts.
capabilityLimits: Missing text prevents a faithful rewrite; partial access limits scope.
Saving edits requires available file tools and user authorization; an in-chat rewrite needs no file tools.
Preserve disable-model-invocation metadata without assuming host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
